proofReview.cornerCriterion: C1>=4. With C3=0, overlapping maximal runs on consecutive rows have identical endpoints; each four-neighbor component is a filled rectangle. Its diagonal contact graph is simple planar and triangle-free; C1=4B-2D then excludes B>=2 at C1=4. Exterior vertices are included and prefix leaves are nonempty.
proofReview.update: A sorted local quadruple contributes exactly [a,b) and [c,d), with sentinelP and zero-length ranges. The eight incident vertex occurrences are fully initialized, sort-uniqued, removed once and restored once after swapping both grid and label-position arrays.
proofReview.minimumCount: Each leaf is one nonempty prefix. All final scores>=4, and full-grid prefix is4, so root minimum-count is the answer. Transactional intermediate states are not queried.
proofReview.integerAndMemory: Every intermediate actual leaf score lies0..V because only present unique-window contributions are removed, then new unique-window contributions added. Every stored minimum was refreshed with ancestors pushed, hence is a past/current score min0..V. Internal lazy is parent-min minus stale-child-min; leaf lazy is leaf-min minus initial leaf score. Thus |lazy|<=V independent of Q; arithmetic<=8P, static int bound1e8 sufficient. Product checked64bit. Payload56P bytes plus4(P+1) scratch; caller arrays and allocator/sanitizer overhead excluded.
proofReview.api: Full original positive-H/W,HW<=1e6,Q<=50000 domain included; same-label swap is a documented extension. Both labels validated before mutation/no-op; all constructor coordinates validated. Deep copy, source-resetting move, checked moved-from getter/update, copy-swap strong assignment, self-copy/self-move and input immutability confirmed.
